title: Great Mirror
text: Great Mirror. My daughter needed a new mirror for her entry. This one is larger than her previous one. She's renting an apartment and can't install it to the wall, so she keeps it on an entry table and leans it against the wall. It says the glass is shatterproof, which is good, though we haven't tested that out! lol. The mirror has a simple design, which goes with the room's aesthetics.

product_metadata.title: Varsoul Modern Black Bathroom Wall Mirror - 24x36 Inch Rectangular Vanity Mirror with Brushed Metal Frame
features: 【MODERN & SIMPLE DESIGN】VarSoul's 24-inch circular wall mirror boasts a sleek and chic aesthetic, accentuated by an iron metal frame and polished edge. An ideal choice for a vanity, entryway, or living room décor.

【EXCELLENT QUALITY】Varsoul wall mirror frame is made of quality iron（not aluminum alloy）, which is waterproof and rustproof.With built-in shatterproof membrane and 4 mm MDF back panel makes the large wall mounted mirror more sturdy and safe.
【HD IMAGE】4 mm glass, real HD reflection without distortion. 24x36 inch mirror bathroom provides a clear reflection without vision distortion.

【HORIZONTAL / VERTICAL】3 Pre-installed hooks on the backboard, this matte black bathroom mirror is easy to install, which can be mounted horizontally or vertically.Due to the heavy iron products, please pay attention to safety during installation.

【GOOD PACKAGE & AFTER-SERVICE】Our package has passed professional dropping test to guarantee the mirror keep perfect condition in transit. If there is any issue of our mirror, please feel free to contact us. We will provide excellent customer service for you to solve the issue.
